name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Dark Mocha'
story_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Dark Mocha’ features a distinctive palette that calls to mind Travis Scott’s highly coveted Air Jordan 1 collaboration from 2019. The upper features an off-white leather base with contrasting black leather overlays on the eyestay and toe. Brown nubuck is utilized on the heel overlay and collar flap, accented with a classic Wings logo on the lateral side. A leather tag with Nike Air branding adorns the nylon tongue.
